paper: MP.2018.933 - Lakens & Delacre (2020), Equivalence Testing and the Second Generation P-Value

findings.title: Prose typo misstates the third TOST/SGPV correspondence point ('SGPV = 1' where it should be 'SGPV = 0' / '1-SGPV = 1')
findings.description: The text says: '...we focus on their correspondence at three values, namely where the TOST p = 0.025 and SGPV is 1, where the TOST p = 0.5 and SGPV = 0.5, and where the TOST p = 0.975 and SGPV = 1.' The third item is wrong: at TOST p = 0.975 the SGPV is 0 (equivalently 1-SGPV = 1), i.e. the CI lies outside the equivalence range and the data favour the alternative hypothesis. The correct values appear in Figure 2 and in the same paragraph's 'situation C' description ('the p-value will always be 0.975, and the SGPV is 0'). The error is present in the author's own reproducible source (manuscript.R2.Rmd line 136), so it is not an extraction artifact.
findings.evidence: manuscript.R2.Rmd line 136 vs line 325 (situation C: SGPV=0) and Figure 1 caption line 120 ('1-SGPV = 1'). Independent recomputation at mean=147.7468 gives TOST p=0.9750 and SGPV=0.0000, confirming SGPV=0 is correct.
findings.impact: Cosmetic prose error; no numeric or inferential consequence. The governing figures/caption and situation C are correct, and the following sentence correctly maps SGPV=0 to the alternative hypothesis. Only a reader taking the isolated sentence literally is misled on the third correspondence value.
findings.fix: Change 'and SGPV = 1' to 'and SGPV = 0' (or 'and 1-SGPV = 1') in that sentence.

findings.title: Published OSF links point to empty projects; all open materials actually live on GitHub
findings.description: The badge line states 'All supplementary files can be accessed at OSF: ZP3KF' and the Authors' Note gives osf.io/8crkg for code. As of audit date both OSF nodes' osfstorage have 0 files. The full reproducible set (manuscript.Rmd, functions/, Shiny app source, archive/) exists at the GitHub repository explicitly cited in the Authors' Note, so the Open Materials / Open & reproducible analysis badges are substantiated - but the specific URLs readers are told to click are dead/empty.
findings.evidence: OSF API: /v2/nodes/zp3kf/files/osfstorage/ total=0; /v2/nodes/8crkg/files/osfstorage/ total=0 (2026-09-14). GitHub Lakens/TOST_vs_SGPV holds manuscript.R2.Rmd, functions/SGPV_function.R, TOST_vs_SGPV_app/, archive/.
findings.impact: Findability/archival hygiene only. Materials are fully available and this re-audit reproduced every claim from them; the empty OSF nodes are a broken-link risk and contradict the 'all supplementary files at OSF ZP3KF' wording.
findings.fix: Upload the R functions, reproducible manuscript.Rmd, Shiny app source, and figures to the ZP3KF project (and/or 8crkg), or reword the badge line to point to the GitHub repository.
